summary: Public interest challenge to private hospitals compelling patients to buy medicines from in-house pharmacies at inflated prices; price opacity and lack of regulation alleged; constitutional obligation under Article 21, read with Articles 38, 39, 47; Court refrains from issuing mandatory directions, citing policy domain; matter left to State Governments' discretion; States already have regulatory mechanisms via NPPA, DPCO, Jan Aushadhi schemes; sensitization to exploitation emphasized; petition disposed of with advisory.
final_judgment: Writ petition disposed of with direction to State Governments to consider the issue and take appropriate policy decisions; no mandatory directions issued; interlocutory applications disposed of.
